text: Dear students, welcome to Kids Measures In today's video I am going to explain Difference between OLTP and OLAP system And I will explain this with a very good example I will explain it with a real life example, it will be fun in this video See, first of all we will start with a simple example Let's assume that I have a company whose name is ABC Electronics And we sell electronic items online Like mobiles, computers, laptops, we sell them online Now I have a website, a mobile app On which users come, like you are users You come and search on my app or desktop application And then you buy a particular product So you must be understanding this simple scenario And when you buy, I get a copy of that data I mean I get that transaction And at the end of the year, I know At the end of the financial year That how much total sale I got How much profit or loss I got Or what things happened So this is a simple example of the first model You must be understanding this Now here OLTP, where did OLAP come in? And where did the difference come in between this? So see, it is a very simple example You can see this card Now there are two faces of this card If I take the same company example Now there are two faces of this card This face is towards you and this face is towards me This face is towards you This is OLTP Online Transaction Processing Where you come There is a user interface, an application is made There is a database You open the application or desktop Or open the mobile And there you search for a particular product Then you put it in the cart, buy it You do the payment, all those things You are doing at this end That is the OLTP And this face which I can see This is OLAP Means at the end of the month I check that how much product sale I got Where did I sell more products How much total profit I got What happened if I lost So I am checking all these things at my end So this is towards you, this OLTP This is towards me, this OLAP That is the Analysis Processing Now you have understood all the stories Now see Current data, historical data Means OLTP On which data will you work On current data, which product is available today How much you can say is going on off Like it comes that on Amazon, Flipkart So you are working on current data The sale which was done 6 months ago That is not going on you today You are working on today's data And on whom am I working I am working on historical data How much sale happened today, I don't have to take it now Maybe I should check after a week Or after a month or after a quarter Like big companies say After quarter 1, I got this much revenue So I am checking that Through OLAP system I am checking on historical data Because current data amount will be less But historical data will be in large volume Multidimensional data will be there Multidimensional means Like as an example I will tell you Like if I have to draw this You can draw it like this 3 dimensional data One dimension is my time Here how much happened in 2021 How much happened in 2022 How much is happening in 2023 One dimension means what can I have in one axis Region means like how much sale happened in India How much happened in Japan How much happened in America And on one side what can be my product X axis, Y axis, Z axis On one side product means how much mobile is sold How much computer is sold How much laptop is sold So I work on multidimensional data This is your OLAP system And you work on simple data Day to day transactions You come daily to daily and do transactions Your work is only this I do all these things and then I do decision making Based on what data I have That which product should I put sale on Which product should not be put on Who is giving me more benefit Who is giving me less benefit Sometimes what happens is we are doing a lot of ads But it is not selling And we are doing less of someone's ad and it is selling more So all these things have to be taken decision Normalized data structure The data you are working on is normalized data Simple like you can say structured data Data can be in table and form So there will be a structure The data I am working on in OLAP That is a star schema or snowflake schema I have already defined that You will get the link of that So these are your data models Based on data warehouse Because my data is in warehouses Large volume of data is there Simple queries Obviously if I give you complex You will get stuck somewhere Now see my front end The employees working on it Many employees are doing They are putting daily product Today I put this product or tomorrow I will put this product And I am putting in so much sale So these employees who are working in front line For my company They are using this data And then you are seeing that data But the data I am working on That data only executive The founders of the company They can use that data Or you can say that executives Or analysts Or scientists are using that data So you will understand the main story So that's why simple queries are there But at my end there are complex queries We have to aggregate, integrate We have to join the data So this is a simple fund Then I told you that who is using this data The employees of the front line They are putting daily data How much sale has happened, they are collecting that data Managers are on their head And then finally you are seeing that data Because you are generating that data And we are actually putting that data My employees are putting that data So that you can see that data But the OLAP As I told you earlier Analysts, executive, decision makers And those who are sitting in the big position of the company They use it Require faster response time Obviously You need faster response on OLTP Otherwise you Instead of XYZ company You will go to ABC company Then you will have a faster response But here Because I am not doing daily analysis I may be after 1 week After 2 weeks, after 1 month I am doing that data analysis So the response time can be a little more Data in OLTP system is updated in the real time You did the transaction Minus from your account, plus from mine So this will happen in real time It's not like it's happening after a day I will go crazy for a day You do the transaction on Paytm or Google Pay So at the end, do not refresh Or don't press the back button Till then everyone is stuck When will my transaction be complete Till it is not complete Till then it is not like that It should be done from my account As soon as it is complete, then a relief comes But what will happen at my end Means what will happen in OLAP system Periodically After 1 day, after 10 days It depends on the company's policy It may be updated after a month Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, DB2 RDBMS Simple Structure Data Normalized Data But the analysis that is happening here For that I
